title: Nightjar
subtitle: A quiet listener at dusk.
interpretation: A dusk-plumaged bird pauses along a rising branch, its small bill turned toward open air.
gesture: A low crown and breast flow into the descending tail; folded flight feathers follow the back, with a short wrapped grip supporting the bird.
polish: Fold the flight planes along the flank toward the tail root.
Keep shoulder and covert roots buried with quiet, thin relief.
Retain the low listening profile and the short wrapped grip on a tapering curved branch.
nativeFeatures: Selectively rebuilt native shoulder, covert and flight-feather meshes
Fitted wing-fold shape keys and assembly controls
Native curved branch and short wrapping digits
reference: Body, face, tail and rig retained from the preserved procedural Nightjar delivery; wing and roost regions selectively rebuilt as editable native meshes. Original procedural authoring and whole-body retopology are not recovered.
reviewStatus: Regional wing and roost reconstruction; publication scope and parent observations belong to its immutable review.
